items.headline: Ohtani ends the misery — a 10th-inning walk-off snaps the Dodgers' seven-game skid
items.body: The Dodgers' worst slide of the year is finally over. After blowing a ninth-inning lead in Arizona, Shohei Ohtani dribbled home the winner in the 10th for a nervy 2-1 win — his first walk-off as a Dodger.
items.say: Did you catch the Dodgers finally win? Took an Ohtani walk-off in extras to stop the bleeding.

items.headline: Kelsey Mitchell makes history — and Caitlin Clark stuffed the stat sheet in a Fever win
items.body: Mitchell poured in 27 for her 16th straight game of 20-plus points — a new WNBA single-season record — while Clark added 26 points and 11 assists as Indiana held off Chicago 90-86.
items.say: Kelsey Mitchell just set a WNBA record — 16 straight 20-point games — with a 26-and-11 from Clark right beside her.

items.headline: A star is born in Vegas — Salkilld chokes out Gamrot in Round 1
items.body: In his first UFC main event, Aussie Quillan Salkilld took the veteran's back and sank a rear-naked choke late in the opening round — his fourth straight first-round finish, and now a perfect 6-0 in the UFC.
items.say: This Aussie kid Salkilld is the real deal — submitted a top-ranked vet in the first round to go 6-0.

items.headline: Win or go home — the FedExCup bubble bursts today at the Wyndham
items.body: It's the last stop of the PGA Tour regular season, and only the top 70 make the playoffs. Beau Hossler and Michael Brennan share the lead into Sunday, with a pack of stars sweating the cut line.
items.say: Today's the last day to make golf's playoffs — a bunch of guys are playing to save their whole season.

items.headline: Nearly back — the Premier League returns in two weeks, and the Shield's next Sunday
items.body: Champions Arsenal open at home to newly-promoted Coventry on Aug 21, with Newcastle–Liverpool and Man City–Bournemouth also on the opening slate. First, a trophy: Arsenal meet Man City in the Community Shield next Sunday.
items.say: Footy's basically back — Premier League kicks off in two weeks and the Community Shield's next weekend.

items.headline: Stray Kids are back — new mini-album 'THIS & THAT' is here
items.body: The K-pop juggernauts dropped their first full-group release of the year, an eight-track EP written and produced by their own in-house trio, 3RACHA. The 'This & That' video racked up millions of views within hours.
items.say: Stray Kids just dropped a new album — the video blew past ten million views on day one.

items.headline: Big guy, big trouble — 'Reacher' Season 4 lands Wednesday
items.body: Alan Ritchson's one-man wrecking crew is back Aug 12 on Prime Video, pulled into a deadly mystery after a chance run-in on the Philadelphia subway. Three episodes drop day one.
items.say: New season of Reacher drops Wednesday — three episodes right out of the gate.

items.headline: DC goes full detective — 'Lanterns' premieres next Sunday
items.body: The buzzy HBO Max series pairs Aaron Pierre's rookie Green Lantern John Stewart with Kyle Chandler's grizzled Hal Jordan as intergalactic cops untangling a very earthly murder. It debuts Aug 16.
items.say: Have you seen the Lanterns trailer? It's basically a Green Lantern detective show — looks slick.

items.headline: Pups meet dinosaurs — 'PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie' hits theaters Friday
items.body: The next big-screen adventure strands the pups on a dino-filled island where they befriend a marooned pup named Rex. If there are little kids in the picture, that's the Aug 14 weekend sorted.
items.say: If you've got kids, the new PAW Patrol dinosaur movie is out Friday — weekend plan, done.
